programmes.d: Hermosa Beach is one of Los Angeles' last funky beach towns--a place where the hip, young, rich, and beautiful come together.
Story of the murder that ruined Bermuda's reputation as the "safest place in the world." In 1996, 17-year-old Canadian tourist Rebecca Middleton was killed--and her presumed murderer walked free.

Shots rang out into the cool San Francisco night. It was fall, 1991 and Artie Mitchell lay on the floor dying. His girlfriend frantically called 911 as his brother stood over him with the muder weapon in his hand.
On November 29, 1992 the tiny town of Gibsonton, Florida was hurled into the national spotlight. It was the night that someone put three bullets into the head of Grady Stiles.
Outspoken Joe Vogler was a hero to many Alaskans, especially in Fairbanks, where a last-outpost image still attracts fortune hunters and exiles from the "Lower 48."
A probe into the mysterious death of artist Ana Mendieta, who plunged from her 34th-floor apartment in New York City in 1985.
On the night of June 12th of 1994, Newberry police officers found the body of Vickie Lander Beckham dead in her car on a local back road.
Dr. G has a challenge on her hands: a victim's body spent days decaying before it was found, and decomposition could get in the way of her investigation.
Dr. G suspects that someone is responsible for a vagrant's unusual death. She’ll only discover the truth by finding answers to the strange events surrounding this curious case.
Even with many leads, including an insulin overdose, a tooth infection, and chronic lupus, the pieces don’t add up in the case of a woman's death. Will Dr. G be able to uncover the truth?
An otherwise healthy child had been complaining of stomach pains. Could the medicine his mother had recently given him be to blame? Or could his death be from something more sinister?
All circumstances point to foul play in the case of a dead hunter and the police fear that a killer is on the loose. Dr. G must provide them with answers before there are more victims.
In an unprecedented double autopsy, Dr. G is determined to find out who is accountable for these odd deaths and solve the mystery of a love triangle gone awry.
Dr. G must decide if she can perform a successful autopsy without the deceased's organs. As she ponders the decision, we are given a rare glimpse into a different side of Dr. G’s job.
An 82-year-old woman appears to have committed suicide by overdosing on painkillers, but Dr. G finds evidence that suggests that she may have died of a heart attack.
Dr. G performs an autopsy on an alleged hit-and-run victim but finds no evidence of vehicular injury on the 41-year-old man's body. Could his alcoholism have had a role in his death?
A 94-year-old woman dies in the hospital after having a convulsion. The case becomes the business of the medical examiner's office when no one will sign her death certificate.
An infant and his two-year-old sister are found dead in a house shared by two families. At first, they are believed to have died from either carbon monoxide poisoning or cold medicine overdoses.
A decomposing body is found in a pond and a tent is found nearby. Dr. G performs the autopsy in the morgue but finds few clues other than fingerprints and mouthwash in the stomach.
Examining the case of a man who murdered his wife after she allegedly admitted to an affair.
A man murders his estranged wife's lover after confronting the couple in an Edmonton parking lot.
A woman pleads self-defense in the stabbing death of her allegedly abusive husband.
A financier lives after his socialite wife shoots him six times in their Calgary condo.
A woman shoots her allegedly abusive husband in his sleep.
A woman shoots her abusive common-law husband after he leaves her and their two children for another woman.
Doctor Harold Shipman was convicted of killing 15 patients in 2000, but he is thought to have killed up to 215. Discover how he was eventually caught by detectives.

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: Stephanie Slater
programmes.d: Estate agent Stephanie Slater reveals the story of her abduction, rape and incarceration, which occurred in 1992 whilst showing a man around a house.

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Russell Murders
programmes.d: Bludgeoned to death whilst walking down a country lane, the horrific murders of Lin and Megan Russell made worldwide news. Discover the events of that shocking day.

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: Beverly Allitt
programmes.d: Beverley Allitt was thought to be a 'model' nurse. Very astute, caring and always willing to help, why did she murder four children and attempt to kill 11 others?
